name: Salesforce MCP Server
description: Enables natural language interactions with Salesforce data and metadata, supporting queries, data manipulation, custom object/field management, Apex code operations, and debug logging across multiple authentication methods.

rawRecord.description: Enables natural language interactions with Salesforce data and metadata, supporting queries, data manipulation, custom object/field management, Apex code operations, and debug logging across multiple authentication methods.

SALESFORCE_TOKEN.description: Your Salesforce security token (required for User_Password authentication)

SALESFORCE_PASSWORD.description: Your Salesforce password (required for User_Password authentication)

SALESFORCE_USERNAME.description: Your Salesforce username (required for User_Password authentication)

SALESFORCE_CLIENT_ID.description: Your Salesforce Connected App Client ID (required for OAuth_2.0_Client_Credentials authentication)

SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL.description: Your Salesforce instance URL (e.g., https://your-domain.my.salesforce.com). Optional for User_Password (default: https://login.salesforce.com). Required for OAuth_2.0_Client_Credentials.

SALESFORCE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your Salesforce Connected App Client Secret (required for OAuth_2.0_Client_Credentials authentication)

SALESFORCE_CONNECTION_TYPE.description: The type of Salesforce authentication to use. Valid values: 'Salesforce_CLI', 'User_Password', 'OAuth_2.0_Client_Credentials'
